AutomaticVolumeAdjustment: Its session-start hook fails against the current VolumeControl API. Current Enigma2 has built-in volume adjustment; this legacy add-on is excluded.
BirthdayReminder: Upstream network sharing deserializes unauthenticated pickle data. Not published pending safe serialization or removal of that feature.
EPGTranslator: No-playing-service screen faults were investigated; the external translation request also failed on the receiver. Not published.
FTPBrowser: Additional Paramiko dependency and remote-server operations have not been validated; the bundled FileCommander remains available.
WeatherPlugin: External weather provider and credentials have not been validated.
BouquetMakerXtream: A redistributable license was not established during this audit. M3UIPTV is the validated native playlist alternative.
